-- ¡LOTERIA: GAME ON!
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = '¡LOTERIA: GAME ON!' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2023', 'Latinx Theatre', 'Family Show', 'Contemporary', 'Cultural')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- Boeing, Boeing
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Boeing, Boeing' AND t.name IN ('Comedy', '2023', 'Farce', '1960s', 'French Comedy', 'College Theatre')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- The Merry Wives of Windsor
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'The Merry Wives of Windsor' AND t.name IN ('Shakespeare', '2022', 'Comedy', 'College Theatre', 'Elizabethan', 'Farce')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- An Inspector Calls
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'An Inspector Calls' AND t.name IN ('Drama', '2022', 'Mystery', 'British Theatre', 'Social Commentary', 'Summer Stock')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to the Forum' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2022', 'Comedy', 'Stephen Sondheim', 'Ancient Rome', 'Farce')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
